mapper.select: SELECT id, slot_code AS slotCode, provider_code AS providerCode, model_id AS modelId, gen_params AS genParams, enabled FROM model_slot
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO model_slot (slot_code, provider_code, model_id, gen_params, enabled) VALUES (#{slotCode}, #{providerCode}, #{modelId}, #{genParams}, COALESCE(#{enabled}, 1))
